name: Relation Verify → ID Pair
process:
treatment_target_ids = {'D012640', 'D009422', 'D064420', 'D001282', 'D006333', 'D009069'}
hid = state.get('head_id') or ''
tid = state.get('tail_id') or ''
if tid in treatment_target_ids:
    __result__ = []
else:
    result = state.get('result')
    if result == '$':
        # Title-only co-occurrence guard: reject if head and tail appear together only in the title
        text = state.get('text') or ''
        parts = text.split('.', 1)
        title = parts[0].lower() if parts else ''
        body = parts[1].lower() if len(parts) > 1 else ''
        head = state.get('head') or ''
        tail = state.get('tail') or ''
        head_in_title = head.lower() in title
        tail_in_title = tail.lower() in title
        head_in_body = head.lower() in body
        tail_in_body = tail.lower() in body
        if head_in_title and tail_in_title and not (head_in_body and tail_in_body):
            __result__ = []
        else:
            line = f"{hid} | {tid}" if hid and tid else ''
            __result__ = [line] if line else []
    else:
        __result__ = []
